 Badminton: Lakshya Sen and K Srikanth advance to Men’s Singles second round of Hong Kong Super 500 
 Ace Indian shuttlers, Lakshya Sen and Kidambi Srikanth advanced to the Men’s Singles second round of Hong Kong Open Badminton Championships today. In the opening round, Srikanth defeated Japan’s Koki Watanabe 21-16, 16-21, 21-9 while Lakshya beat France’s Arnaud Merklé 14-21, 21-16, 25-23. 
 In Women’s Singles, Rakshitha Ramraj and Ashmita Chaliha also advanced to the second round. Rakshitha defeated Mia Blichfeldt 21-18, 21-18 while Ashmita defeated compatriot Isharani Baruah 12-21, 21-13, 21-12 in the round of 32.
